tips.text: Join a clan that already researched the Pupacyst chain and copy the blueprint instead of researching it yourself.
Queue the research steps back to back and gather Rubedo and Salvage while the timers run.
Do not confuse Mutagen Samples, which pay for research, with Mutagen Mass, the crafted item the build needs.
Add the Control Module and Salvage that each Mutagen Mass needs to your build tally.
Players call the chain a few focused Deimos sessions with a loot frame, with little to complain about.
